name: novelty
prompt: Novelty of insight: how much genuinely new understanding the post contributes — an idea, distinction, or synthesis a well-read rationalist would not already possess.

name: alpha
prompt: Technical alpha: how much genuine, exciting technical signal the text delivers to a top-percentile practitioner already fluent in its area — mechanisms, measurements, techniques, or design-space dimensions they did not already hold and could not cheaply regenerate from standard documentation — as opposed to noise: competent restatement of known material, topic heat, jargon, or performed novelty.

name: rigor
prompt: Epistemic rigor: how carefully the post handles evidence and inference — claims proportioned to support, alternatives considered, uncertainty stated where it exists.
